_about: A model of dynamic data masking on the Customers table. For each column set mask to null (no mask) or {"function": "default" | "email" | "random" | "partial", ...}: random takes start and end, partial takes prefix, padding and suffix. unmask lists the roles granted UNMASK. salary_protection is "masking" or "column-level security".

needs.Email: Agents may see that an address exists and its first letter, never the full address.
needs.CardNumber: Agents confirm a card by its last four digits only.
needs.Gender: Agents never need it; show nothing of it.
needs.BirthMonth: A number 1-12. Agents never need it, but test screens must show plausible values.
needs.Salary: Agents must not be able to learn a customer's salary at all, even by filtering on it.

readers: Agents and SupportLeads are workspace Viewers who query through the SQL analytics endpoint. SupportLeads handle disputes and must see real values.
